description: Franchise - Sewer is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Polygons delineating the sewer franchise areas in Pierce County. The franchise granted allows the holder of the franchise to operate in County Right-of-Ways, though it is possible that the holder of the franchise does not provide service in all of their franchise area. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are franchise, sewer. The table has 34 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
